summary: Mobile puzzle game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Cut the Rope
entries.definitive_edition: Current official mobile app build with app/device state documented

emulation.notes: Use native mobile device where possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official mobile app on calibrated touch device

primary.why: Cut the Rope is a touch-first mobile physics puzzle game. The current official mobile app is the practical route, while older browser, Windows Phone, Nintendo, and remastered variants are separate access/control histories.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current App Store or Google Play build. Record device, OS, app version, ads/IAP state, level packs present, touch settings, star/completion state, and whether Remastered or older ports were compared.

secondary.platform: Cut the Rope Remastered / Cut the Rope 3
secondary.what_to_play: Use separately if documenting remaster/series evolution.
secondary.why: They are not replacements for the original app state.

all_releases.reason: primary if Android is the available official access path.

all_releases.platform: Browser / Windows / Nintendo DS / Nintendo 3DS / Mac and other ports

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Current app content, ads/IAP, and level packs differ from launch and from remastered/ported versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record app version, ads/IAP, level packs, device/OS, and completion state.
